configbackup.label: Server backup
configbackup.description: Backs up everything the bot holds for the server — configuration, structure and data (currency, items, Endless Road, levels…) — on demand or on a schedule.

command.description: Export or restore a full backup of the server.
command.export: Download a full server backup (config + data).
command.import: Restore the server from a backup file.

opt.file: The backup file to import (.json or .json.gz).
opt.recreate: Recreate missing channels/roles on this server (default: yes).
opt.data: Include member data: currency, items, Road… (default: yes).
opt.restoreData: Also restore member data — overwrites this server's data (default: yes).

export.title: 💾 Server backup
export.done: Here is the backup of **{count}** module(s). Keep this file safe: you can restore it with `/backup import`.
export.structure: 🏗️ Structure included: **{channels}** channel(s) and **{roles}** role(s) referenced — they can be recreated on import to another server.
export.data: 📦 Data included: **{rows}** row(s) across **{tables}** table(s) — currency, items and inventories, Endless Road, levels, sanctions…
export.noData: ℹ️ Member data **not included**: this file only holds the configuration.
export.shared: 🔗 Shared dependencies: **{rows}** row(s) of a common catalogue (gacha…) referenced by this data — so the restore holds on another bot instance.

import.title: ✅ Server restored
import.dataSkipped: ℹ️ The file contained member data: it was **not** restored (option disabled).
import.structure: 🏗️ Structure: **{channelsCreated}** channel(s) created · {channelsReused} reused — **{rolesCreated}** role(s) created · {rolesReused} reused.
import.structureFailed: ⚠️ **{failed}** item(s) could not be created — the bot needs the **Manage Roles** and **Manage Channels** permissions (and to be high enough in the hierarchy).
import.structureMissing: ℹ️ This backup does not include the structure (channels/roles). Re-export it from the latest bot version to enable automatic recreation.
import.otherGuild: ℹ️ This backup comes from another server — double-check the settings afterwards.
import.tooLarge: ❌ The file is too large. It is probably not a valid backup.
import.downloadFailed: ❌ Could not download the attached file. Please try again.
import.invalidJson: ❌ The file is not valid JSON.
import.invalidShape: ❌ This file is not a valid Vakz-Bot backup.
import.shared: 🔗 Shared catalogue: **{added}** row(s) added, **{matched}** already present and re-matched.
